title: kgateway nightly attached-routes measurements, July–October 2026
description: 864 control-plane performance measurements extracted from the public GitHub Actions logs of the kgateway nightly load-test workflow (attached-routes suite), 25 July – 21 October 2026, across the main, v2.4.x and v2.3.x branches, two Kubernetes versions, two validation modes and 1,000- and 5,000-route scales. Accompanies the ICPE 2027 industrial paper 'From One-Off Benchmarks to Nightly Performance Gates: Control-Plane Regression Testing for a Kubernetes Gateway API Implementation'. See README.md for provenance, columns and caveats.
